title: Custom Distribute Liquids Function
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Gather required hardware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect an Opentrons OT‑2 robot with OT‑2 Run App version 3.15.0 or later, a single‑channel pipette (p300), compatible 300 µL tip rack, a Corning 24‑well plate (3.4 mL flat) as source, a Corning 6‑well plate (16.8 mL flat) as destination, and a trash plate for blowout.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided source and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol script
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 App’s Protocol tab, upload the .py file that contains the custom distribute_custom function.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the 300 µL tip rack in slot A1, the source 24‑well plate in the slot indicated for Plate 1, the destination 6‑well plate in the slot indicated for Plate 2, and the trash plate (blowout location) in the slot indicated for trash_plate['A1']. Ensure the deck layout matches the protocol’s deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, run the calibration routine for the tip rack, source plate, destination plate, trash plate, and the p300 single‑channel pipette according to the on‑screen instructions.

steps.title: Configure custom distribute function
steps.instruction: In the uploaded Python script call the function as shown: `distribute_custom(p300, 50, plate1['A1'], plate2.rows_by_name()['A'], 30, trash_plate['A1'], 10)`. This will pick up a tip from A1 of the tip rack, aspirate 230.0 µL (50 µL + 30 µL overage) from A1 of Plate 1 at 92.86 µL/s, perform a 10.0 µL air gap, and dispense 60.0 µL into each well of Plate 2 at the same speed, finishing with a blowout to trash_plate['A1'].

steps.title: Execute protocol on OT‑2
steps.instruction: After all setup steps are complete, press ‘Run’ in the OT‑2 App to start the protocol.
